headline: PF ceiling is ₹25,000.
Arrears are the open case.

events.text: Ceiling rises to ₹25,000, bringing 51 lakh+ more employees under EPFO
One ECR with the month split: 1–16 Sep at ₹15,000 and 17–30 Sep at ₹25,000
On backdated arrears, EPFO guidance doesn't expressly say which ceiling applies

source: Business Today (Sep 2026), EPFO FAQs via SGCMS, TaxGuru (Nov 2026)
